name: Exp_NRTR
summary: This Expert Advisor trades based on the NRTR (Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse) custom indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals while optionally closing opposite positions. It uses a configurable money management system with multiple margin modes and includes new bar detection to avoid redundant signal processing on the same bar.
summary_zh: 该EA基于NRTR（Nick Rypock Trailing Reverse）自定义指标进行交易，在向上信号时开多仓，在向下信号时开空仓，同时可选平掉反向持仓。它使用可配置的资金管理系统，支持多种保证金模式，并包含新K线检测以避免在同一根K线上重复处理信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用NRTR指标作为核心趋势跟踪策略，NRTR是一种动态止损反转指标，通过跟踪价格趋势的方向变化来产生交易信号。入场条件为：当NRTR指标的上行信号缓冲区（buffer 2）有有效值时开多仓，当下行信号缓冲区（buffer 3）有有效值时开空仓。出场条件包括两个方面：一是基于反向信号平仓（多单在下行信号时平仓，空单在上行信号时平仓），二是基于固定的止损和止盈参数平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举实现，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损自由保证金、亏损余额和固定手数五种模式计算仓位大小。资金管理依赖于TradeAlgorithms.mqh中封装的交易算法，包括滑点控制和信号时间戳管理。EA还实现了新K线检测机制（CIsNewBar类），确保每个信号只在一个K线周期内处理一次，避免重复开仓。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the NRTR indicator as its core trend-following strategy, where NRTR is a dynamic trailing stop-reverse indicator that generates trading signals based on directional changes in price trends. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the NRTR indicator's up-signal buffer (buffer 2) has a valid non-empty value, and a sell position is opened when the down-signal buffer (buffer 3) has a valid non-empty value. Exit conditions are twofold: first, reverse-signal-based closing where long positions close on down signals and short positions close on up signals; second, fixed stop-loss and take-profit based closing. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five calculation modes: free margin, balance, loss-free margin, loss-balance, and fixed lot size. Money management relies on trading algorithms encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh, including slippage control and signal timestamp management. The EA also implements a new bar detection mechanism (CIsNewBar class) to ensure each signal is processed only once per bar period, preventing redundant position openings.

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号K线索引（用于获取指标值的K线位置）

pros: 具有完整的新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线上重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
支持五种仓位计算模式，资金管理灵活度高，适应不同风险偏好
信号处理逻辑严谨，包含Recount重算机制，确保指标数据加载失败时不会错误交易
止损止盈参数可配置，且止盈是止损的两倍（默认），具备正期望收益比特征
买卖方向开关独立控制，可灵活启用或禁用单向交易
pros_en: Implements a robust new bar detection mechanism to prevent redundant trade entries on the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Supports five position sizing modes, offering high flexibility in money management to suit different risk preferences
Rigorous signal processing logic with a Recount retry mechanism ensures no erroneous trades occur when indicator data fails to load
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit with a default 1:2 risk-reward ratio, exhibiting positive expectancy characteristics
Independent buy/sell direction switches allow flexible enabling or disabling of unidirectional trading
cons: 依赖自定义NRTR指标，指标文件缺失时EA将无法初始化，可移植性较差
止损值1000点和止盈值2000点偏大，在低波动性市场中可能导致长时间浮亏
缺乏点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能在不利价格处入场
核心交易逻辑依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh外部库，无法从本文件中完全评估平仓和开仓的具体实现细节
没有显式的最大持仓数量限制或持仓时间限制，在震荡市场中可能频繁反转造成连续亏损
cons_en: Depends on a custom NRTR indicator file; EA fails to initialize if the indicator is missing, resulting in poor portability
Stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are relatively large, potentially leading to prolonged drawdowns in low-volatility markets
Lacks a spread filter mechanism, which may result in entries at unfavorable prices in high-spread environments
Core trading logic depends on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library, making it impossible to fully evaluate position open/close implementation details from this file alone
No explicit maximum position count limit or maximum holding time limit, which may cause frequent reversals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，当当前点差超过阈值时暂停交易，避免高点差环境下的不利入场
增加最大同时持仓数量限制和最大持仓时间限制，防止震荡行情中的频繁反转亏损
将NRTR指标逻辑内嵌或增加指标文件存在性检查，提高EA的可移植性和健壮性
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to pause trading when the current spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unfavorable entries in high-spread conditions
Add maximum concurrent position count limit and maximum holding time limit to prevent frequent reversal losses in ranging markets
Embed the NRTR indicator logic internally or add indicator file existence checks to improve EA portability and robustness

risk_points: 依赖外部自定义指标和库文件，缺失时EA无法运行，存在运行环境依赖风险
默认止损1000点较大，在小周期交易中可能导致单笔亏损过大
缺乏点差过滤，在高点差品种上可能产生滑点损失
震荡行情中NRTR频繁反转信号可能导致连续止损
risk_points_en: Dependency on external custom indicator and library files; EA cannot run if missing, posing runtime environment risk
Default stop-loss of 1000 points is large, potentially causing excessive single-trade losses on smaller timeframes
Lack of spread filter may result in slippage losses on high-spread instruments
Frequent NRTR reversal signals in ranging markets may lead to consecutive stop-loss hits
